question.text: A PM receives a complaint on portfolio drift. The CO must respond within:

explanation.text: The Logic: Portfolio managers are required to take adequate steps for redressal of investor grievances within 21 calendar days from receipt of the complaint. The Trap: The other timelines (7, 14 or 60 calendar days) do not match the prescribed grievance-redressal period. Note: The 21-calendar-day clock starts from receipt of the complaint by the portfolio manager.
